attackClass: step-up store: strict SET NX reply comparison (D3.7 discovery)
summary: RedisStepUpChallengeStore.create() accepted only the exact string 'OK' or boolean true from the SET NX reply; a real Predis client answers a Predis\Response\Status object whose string form is 'OK', so every challenge create() threw and every step-up begin failed closed on a real deployment client. The bundle's own tests passed only because the fake client returned the literal string. Fixed: the store normalizes the reply (Predis Status via its string form, phpredis boolean, bare 'OK'/'1' strings; everything else, including the nil answer of a lost NX race, stays a refusal, fail-closed) and a real-Predis suite leg walks begin() through complete() against a live redis-server under KC_REDIS_URL. The repro boots a real Predis client, enrolls, and calls begin(); the expected transcript is begin_status 200; the observed transcript is 200 (REFUTED).
